config.notes: SIT course pages (www.sit.ac.nz/programme/course/<title>[/campus/<campus>], also /programme/id/<n>) are server-rendered and show the domestic view. Key Details: "Level: 7", "Duration: ... Study Modes: ... Dates: ApplyOnline... --> 2027 Intake 1: 09 February to 04 June" / "2027 Semester 1: 15 February to 25 June" / "2027: 18 January to 28 May" / "2027 Year 1: 22 February ..."; intakes = the START month of each line (pick all; Year 2/Year 3 continuing-student lines are not read). Application Criteria prints IELTS with the overall first ("IELTS Academic: 6.0 overall, with no band below 5.5"). No fee is read: the Fees section is domestic (Zero Fees / direct material costs); international fees are a link to a central page, or "International Fees $100 per credit" on distance programmes, or a whole-programme amount (one page: $12500 for a 17-week certificate). Central calendar: https://www.sit.ac.nz/Fees-Enrolments/Important-Dates (2026 Semester 1 = February, Semester 2 = July); course pages print their own dates so no term_months are needed. International view check (5 Oct 13:02): SIT course pages have no international view or URL variant; the page prints "Fees: Domestic Fees ... International Fees can be found here" (a link to a central page not held in stored links). 20 distance (SIT Online) pages print "International Fees $100 per credit" with no year; one on-campus certificate prints a whole-programme amount ($12500). Programme pages for 9 catalogue titles now show only the generic Programmes page ("The course might not be available"). 5 Oct 15:22: entry_requirement = Application Criteria section up to Language Requirements / Mature Applicants (review only). No exit-award wording on SIT pages.
